StageSource.Name: Stage source
StageSource.Hint: Where the stage folder lives. Choose "The Forge Asset Library" on The Forge.

StageRoot.Name: Stage folder
StageRoot.Hint: Folder with the stage images. All subfolders are included; folders do not affect grouping.

CardSource.Name: Card source
CardSource.Hint: Where the card folder lives. Choose "The Forge Asset Library" on The Forge.

CardRoot.Name: Card folder
CardRoot.Hint: Folder with the NPC cards (images in 2:3). Subfolders are read as well.

CardSize.Name: Card size
CardSize.Hint: Height of a card shown to the players, as a share of the window height. With many cards they all become smaller, so they fit side by side.

CardTransition.Name: Card entrance
CardTransition.Hint: How a card appears for the players and leaves again. With reduced motion set in the system, every option becomes a short fade.
CardTransition.a2b1: At its place, the others move along (fade with a slight zoom)
CardTransition.a1b1: Place opens, card steps forward (fade with a slight zoom)
CardTransition.a1b2: Place opens, card turns over like a playing card
CardTransition.a1b3: Place opens, card comes in from above
CardTransition.simple: Simple: fade, the others jump to their place

CardsOnStageSwitch.Name: Cards on stage switch
CardsOnStageSwitch.Hint: What happens to the shown cards when you switch the stage: they stay, the dialog ends (the cast is emptied), or the stage browser asks each time.

CardPosition.Name: Card position
CardPosition.Hint: Where the cards stand for the players on stages without a position of their own (set per stage in its settings: click the stage name in the stage browser).

TagOrder.Name: Tag order
TagOrder.Hint: Order of the tag prefixes on tiles and in the tag editor, separated by commas. Prefixes not listed follow after them, tags without a prefix come last. A tile shows as many tags as fit into one line; the rest appear on hover.

VariantPattern.Name: Variant pattern
VariantPattern.Hint: How variants are recognised in the file names of stages and cards. A template with {name} and {variant}, e.g. {name} ({variant}), or a regular expression between slashes with the named groups name and variant.

ThumbSource.Name: Thumbnail storage
ThumbSource.Hint: Where preview images of the stages are stored. “Automatic” uses The Forge Asset Library on The Forge and the user data folder otherwise.

ThumbRoot.Name: Thumbnail folder
ThumbRoot.Hint: Folder for the preview images. Empty means stagecraft/thumbs (on The Forge modules/stagecraft/thumbs). Stagecraft creates numbered subfolders in it.

StageTransition.Name: Stage transition
StageTransition.Hint: How the previous stage makes way for the next one, for the players and for you in the player view. The transition starts once the new stage is drawn with its lights. With reduced motion it becomes a short fade.

StageFit.Name: Stage image fit
StageFit.Hint: How the stage image fits the players' screen. Players cannot pan or zoom on the stage scene; resizing the window fits the image again.
StageFit.cover: Fill the screen (edges may be cut off)
StageFit.contain: Show the whole image (bars where the ratio differs)

Errors.GMOnly: Only a Gamemaster can do this.
Errors.NoStageRoot: No stage folder is set. Choose one in the Stagecraft settings.
Errors.NoCardRoot: No card folder is set. Choose one in the Stagecraft settings.

Browser.Title: Stagecraft – Stages
Browser.Truncated: The scan stopped at a limit; not all images are listed.
Browser.FolderErrors: {count} folder(s) could not be read. See the browser console for details.
Browser.NoIndex: No index yet. Choose “Rescan” in the window menu (⋮) to read the stage folder.
Browser.NoImages: The stage folder contains no images.
Browser.SelectModeHint: Selection mode: a click selects tiles instead of switching the stage. Without the mode: Cmd/Ctrl+click selects one, Shift+click a range. Alt/Option+click opens the image's tags. Shift+click on a variant button shows it large while Shift is held.
Browser.SelectAllHint: Selects all visible tiles, so a search narrows the selection.
Browser.ReviewNotice: The scan found things to review: {items}.
Browser.FilterHint: Matching tags and variants appear while typing; Enter adds the highlighted one as a filter. #night + Enter sets a tag filter directly, /night + Enter a variant filter.
Browser.NoRoot: No stage folder is set. Choose one in the Stagecraft settings.
Browser.RescanWhere: Rescan: window menu ⋮ at the top right
Browser.InfoSearchItems:
Typing shows matching tags and variants; Enter adds the highlighted one as a filter.
#night + Enter sets a tag filter directly.
/night + Enter sets a variant filter directly.
The “Search scopes” button sets where plain text searches.

CardBrowser.Title: Stagecraft – Cards
CardBrowser.FilterHint: Matching tags appear while typing; Enter adds the highlighted one as a filter. #tag + Enter sets a tag filter directly.
CardBrowser.SelectModeHint: Selection mode: a click selects cards instead of showing them. Without the mode: Cmd/Ctrl+click selects one, Shift+click a range. Alt/Option+click opens the image's tags. Shift+click on a variant button shows it large while Shift is held.
CardBrowser.NoRoot: No card folder is set. Choose one in the Stagecraft settings.
CardBrowser.NoIndex: No index yet. Choose “Rescan” in the window menu (⋮) to read the card folder.
CardBrowser.NoImages: The card folder contains no images.
CardBrowser.InsertEnd: Insert the next card at the end
CardBrowser.Position: Card position on the stage now shown
CardBrowser.PositionNoStage: No stage from the index is shown.
CardBrowser.TooMany: At most {max} cards fit into the cast. Remove one first.
CardBrowser.NoneShown: The cast is empty. A click on a tile shows a card, dragging it here adds it hidden.
CardBrowser.InfoSearchItems:
Typing shows matching tags; Enter adds the highlighted one as a filter.
#tag + Enter sets a tag filter directly.
The “Search scopes” button sets where plain text searches.

Cast.RemoveAllHint: Empty the cast, hidden cards too. They stay under “Recently shown”.
Cast.HideAllHint: Hide all cards; they stay in the cast.
Cast.Full: {count} cards did not fit into the cast (at most {max}).

Draft.PlanHint: Planning mode: clicks change a draft the players do not see. “Show” shows it in one step, the cards turning over in place; “Discard” ends it.
Draft.Label: Draft
Draft.Empty: Click cards to fill the draft. The players see nothing of it.

Dialogs.Label: Dialogs
Dialogs.Name: Name
Dialogs.CardsHint: Change the cards in the draft: “Edit” loads the dialog there, “Save” in the “Draft” strip keeps the changes.
Dialogs.Speaker: Speaker
Dialogs.StageHint: If the dialog has a stage, showing the dialog switches to it, with its light preset.
Dialogs.TagsHint: Enter or “Add” takes the tag; commas separate several. The card browser filters the dialogs by tags like the cards.
Dialogs.NoCardIndex: This browser has no card index. “Rescan” in the card browser’s window menu (⋮) reads the card folder.
Dialogs.NoCards: No card of the dialog “{name}” is in the index any more.
Dialogs.MissingCards: “{name}”: these cards are no longer in the index and are left out: {cards}
Dialogs.MissingStage: “{name}”: the stage {stage} is not in the index; the running stage stays.
Dialogs.CardsRequired: A dialog needs at least one card.
Dialogs.TooMany: At most {max} dialogs can be saved.

Sidebar.CollapseOnStageHint: Collapse the players' sidebar with every stage switch, so the stage is clear. For you only in the player view.
Sidebar.CollapseOnCardsHint: Collapse the players' sidebar before the first card; the cards appear once it is gone. In planning mode before the draft is shown. For you only in the player view.

Thumbs.Label: Previews
Thumbs.SomeFailed: {count} preview images could not be created. See the browser console for details.
Thumbs.Failed: Preview images could not be created: {message}
Thumbs.UploadFailed: Upload to the thumbnail folder failed.

Menu.Name: Preview cache
Menu.Label: Manage preview cache
Menu.Hint: Status of the preview images, create missing ones, recreate all and list orphaned files.

ThumbCache.Title: Stagecraft – Preview cache
ThumbCache.NoIndex: No index yet. Choose “Rescan” in the stage browser’s window menu (⋮) first so previews can be matched to images.
ThumbCache.Unavailable: Uploading to the thumbnail folder failed, so the tiles show the originals. Check storage and folder in the settings.
ThumbCache.RegenerateHint: “Recreate all” starts a new numbered subfolder. Foundry cannot delete files; the previous folder stays and can be deleted by hand afterwards.
ThumbCache.RegenerateConfirm: All {count} preview images will be recreated in the new subfolder {next}. The previous folder {folder} will no longer be used.
ThumbCache.OrphanedHint: These files belong to no image any more, e.g. because it was renamed or deleted. They can be deleted by hand.
ThumbCache.OldFoldersHint: Earlier subfolders from “Recreate all”. They can be deleted by hand, including their contents.
ThumbCache.FailedHint: No preview could be created for these images; see the browser console for details. Their tiles show the original. “Create missing” tries again.

Tags.NothingSelected: The selected locations are no longer in the index.
Tags.AddHint: Enter adds, commas separate several. Prefixes: Session:, Scene:, Plot:, NPC:, Faction:, Location:.

Menu.Name: Stage scene
Menu.Label: Choose stage scene
Menu.Hint: The scene that shows the stages. Stagecraft sets its background image and size on every switch.

StageScene.Title: Stagecraft – Stage scene
StageScene.Hint: On every switch Stagecraft sets the background image, width and height of this scene and removes its padding. Everything else in the scene stays as it is.
StageScene.None: No stage scene chosen yet. Choose a scene or create a new one.
StageScene.Label: Stage scene

ViewLock.PlayerView: Player view: see the stage scene fitted and locked like the players

LockView.Heading: Lock View
LockView.Active: Lock View is active. Stagecraft locks the view on the stage scene itself; deactivating Lock View is recommended.
LockView.ConflictsIntro: These Lock View settings on the stage scene conflict with Stagecraft:
LockView.NoConflicts: Lock View has no view settings on the stage scene.
LockView.ResetConfirm: Remove Lock View's locks, autoscale and forced initial view from the scene “{name}”? Other scenes stay as they are.
LockView.ResetDone: Lock View settings of the stage scene removed.
LockView.Notice: Lock View locks the stage scene and can conflict with Stagecraft's view lock.

EndDialog.Name: End Dialog
EndDialog.Hint: Empty the cast: all cards go, hidden ones too.

EndSpeaker.Name: End speaker
EndSpeaker.Hint: The speaking card no longer speaks; the cards stay.

ShowDraft.Name: Show draft
ShowDraft.Hint: In planning mode: show the draft to the players; the cards turn over in place.

CardsOnStageSwitch.Title: End Dialog?
CardsOnStageSwitch.Text: {count} card(s) are shown. End the dialog with the switch?

Lights.SaveFor: Save the lights and walls on the stage as the preset of “{file}”. Without any, its preset is removed.
Lights.Unsaved: Not saved: the lights and walls on the stage differ from the preset of “{file}”.
Lights.NoStage: No stage from the index is shown, so its lights and walls cannot be saved.
Lights.Saved: Saved {lights} light(s) and {walls} wall(s) as the preset of “{file}”.
Lights.Removed: “{file}” has no lights or walls now; its preset is removed.
Lights.Nothing: “{file}” has no lights, walls or preset; nothing to save.
Lights.TooMany: A preset holds at most {lights} lights and {walls} walls.
Lights.WarnChanged: The lights and walls on “{file}” differ from its saved preset. Switching replaces them.
Lights.WarnNew: The lights and walls on “{file}” are not saved yet. Switching removes them.
Lights.WarnUnindexed: The lights and walls on the stage cannot be saved, because its image is not in the index. Switching removes them.

Stage.NoScene: No stage scene is set, so stages cannot be shown yet.
Stage.Inactive: The stage scene “{name}” is not active. A click changes its image; players see it once it is active.
Stage.NameTooltip: Stage name players see. File: {file}. Click to change name or bar colour.
Stage.NameTooltipUnset: Click to set a stage name players see (otherwise “Stage”) or the bar colour.
Stage.CardPositionHint: Where the cards stand for the players while this location is on stage, for all its variants.
Stage.NameHint: Players see this name instead of “Stage” while this location is shown. Leave empty for “Stage”. File: {file}
Stage.NameManyHint: Players see this name instead of “Stage” while one of these {count} locations is shown. Leave empty for “Stage”.
Stage.ColorHint: Fills the bars when the whole image is shown (setting “Show the whole image”). Empty: the darkened average colour of the image edges.

Errors.NoScene: No stage scene is set. Choose or create one in the Stagecraft settings.
Errors.NoLevel: The stage scene has no level to show the image on.
Errors.NotIndexed: This image is not in the stage index. Please rescan.
Errors.Unreadable: The image could not be read: {src}

Menu.Name: Review tags
Menu.Label: Review tags
Menu.Hint: Tag suggestions from file and folder names, and tags whose file was renamed, moved or deleted.

TagReview.Title: Stagecraft – Review tags
TagReview.NoIndex: No index yet. Choose “Rescan” in the stage browser’s window menu (⋮) first.
TagReview.SuggestionsHint: From the first name part before “ - ” (as Location:…) and from folder names. Only checked tags are added; open a file list to leave out single files.
TagReview.OrphansHint: Tags at paths the last scan did not find, for example after renaming or moving a file.
TagReview.Incomplete: The last scan missed folders or stopped at a limit. Orphaned tags are only shown after a complete scan.
TagReview.MoreMoves: … and {count} more; they are moved as well.
TagReview.RemoveAllConfirm: Remove the tags of all {count} files without match? This cannot be undone; an export beforehand keeps a copy.

Reason.NotFound: No file with this name in the index
Reason.Ambiguous: File name occurs more than once

TagReview.IncompleteCards: The card index has not been read yet, so card tags would look orphaned. Open the card browser and choose “Rescan” in its window menu (⋮); orphaned tags appear afterwards.

Menu.Name: Export / import tags
Menu.Label: Export / import tags
Menu.Hint: Save all tags as a JSON file, edit them externally and read them back in, also for bulk changes or the Eagle import.

TagTransfer.Title: Stagecraft – Export / import tags
TagTransfer.ExportHint: {count} files have tags. The export contains path and tags of each file.
TagTransfer.NoIndex: No index yet. Choose “Rescan” in the stage browser’s window menu (⋮) first; the import matches entries to the scanned files.
TagTransfer.ImportHint: Entries are matched by path, otherwise by unique file name. A preview shows all changes; only “Apply” saves.
TagTransfer.ModeReplace: Replace: the file then has exactly the imported tags
TagTransfer.ModeMerge: Merge: imported tags are added, nothing is removed

Reason.NotFound: No file with this path or name in the index
Reason.Ambiguous: File name occurs more than once; please give the path

Error.TooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
Error.NotJson: The file is not valid JSON.
Error.NotAnObject: The file does not have the expected format.
Error.WrongFormat: This is not a Stagecraft tag file (format missing or wrong).
Error.UnsupportedVersion: This version of the tag format is not supported.
Error.TagsNotAnObject: The “tags” entry is missing or not an object.
Error.TooManyEntries: The file has too many entries.
Error.InvalidKey: Invalid or overlong path; entry skipped.
Error.TagsNotAnArray: Tags are not a list; entry skipped.

History.Label: Recently shown
History.None: Nothing has left the stage yet.
